import math
import statistics

import pytest

from csvstats import column_stats


def _write(tmp_path, text):
    p = tmp_path / "d.csv"
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return p


def test_all_statistics(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a,b\n1,x\n2,y\n3,z\n4,w\n")
    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert s["count"] == 4 and isinstance(s["count"], int)
    assert s["mean"] == 2.5
    assert s["median"] == 2.5
    assert s["min"] == 1.0 and s["max"] == 4.0
    assert s["stdev"] == pytest.approx(statistics.stdev([1, 2, 3, 4]))


def test_values_are_floats(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a\n1\n2\n")
    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert isinstance(s["mean"], float)
    assert isinstance(s["min"], float)
    assert isinstance(s["max"], float)


def test_single_value_stdev_is_zero(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a\n7\n")
    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert s["count"] == 1
    assert s["stdev"] == 0.0
    assert s["median"] == 7.0


def test_empty_and_whitespace_cells_are_ignored(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a,b\n1,x\n,y\n   ,z\n3,w\n")
    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert s["count"] == 2
    assert s["mean"] == 2.0


def test_quoted_fields_and_padded_numbers(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, 'name,a\n"Smith, J", 1.5 \n"x",2.5\n')
    s = column_stats(p, "a")
    assert s["count"] == 2
    assert s["mean"] == 2.0


def test_short_row_is_treated_as_empty(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a,b\n1,x\n2\n")
    s = column_stats(p, "b")
    assert s["count"] == 1


def test_missing_column_raises_key_error(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a,b\n1,2\n")
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        column_stats(p, "c")


def test_non_numeric_cell_names_data_row(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a\n1\n2\nabc\n4\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="row 3"):
        column_stats(p, "a")


def test_non_finite_cell_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a\n1\nnan\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="row 2"):
        column_stats(p, "a")


def test_no_non_empty_cells_raises_value_error(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a,b\n,x\n  ,y\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        column_stats(p, "a")


def test_header_only_raises_value_error(tmp_path):
    p = _write(tmp_path, "a,b\n")
